timeFields.cluster.createdAt: First two-member formation confirmation time; immutable
timeFields.cluster.confirmedAt: Same as createdAt; immutable and the first time cluster identity exists
timeFields.member.memberAddedAt: First time that member is visible in this cluster
timeFields.cluster.lastMemberConfirmedAt: Derived max confirmedAt among members visible as-of evaluationTime
timeFields.referencePriceEffectiveAt: The memberAddedAt that created the current projected mean

asOfProjection.state: Existing lifecycle projected only from events/candles confirmed at or before evaluationTime

appendOrdering: Existing cluster lifecycle is projected through candidate confirmedAt before append eligibility is checked
minimalImplementationRequirement: An append-only member ledger plus an incremental current-state projector; full general-purpose event sourcing is not required
